Registered Nurse – Internal Medicine Ward

Region Västerland runs four hospitals and employs 12 000 people. We care for patients across the whole county.

Your role
- Plan, carry out and evaluate nursing care for patients on a 28-bed internal medicine ward
- Administer medication and monitor patients' condition around the clock
- Work closely with physicians, assistant nurses and physiotherapists
- Supervise nursing students during their clinical placements

Who you are
- Swedish nursing licence (legitimation) or a licence application in progress
- Experience of hospital ward work is an advantage
- You communicate well in Swedish and English

We offer
- Salary according to the collective agreement, with a bonus for evening and weekend shifts
- A structured introduction programme for new nurses
- Paid continuing education
